name: DOOM 3
description: DOOM 3 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter and survival horror game and the third main game in the Doom series.

steam.store_details: Comes only with the 'DOOM 3' purchase, together with Resurrection of Evil, which Steam lists as a separate game but installs into this folder and runs from the same exe.

gog.store_details: Comes with the 'DOOM 3' purchase, together with Resurrection of Evil, and Heroic installs that purchase as two library entries — this one is the classic game (its folder ends '.../DOOM 3').

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: DOOM 3 ships with its EAX sound options off, so there's no reverb.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb in Resurrection of Evil
audio_settings.reason: Resurrection of Evil ships with its EAX sound options off, so there's no reverb.
